question: Is AEF's Form 990 line 11f (0.40-0.46% of average assets, TY2022-24) a fair measure of the average adviser fee paid from AEF funds? Read AEF's audited financial statements (investment-fee note; Schedule D Part XI/XII shows 11f netted in the audit), its Schedule O, and the share of AEF assets in fee-free or commission accounts. Repeat for RCF (0.23%)
conclusion_affected: AEF and RCF 'with adviser' all-in rows; reasonableness of the 1.00% illustrative adviser fee
rationale: AEF has no in-house investment management and requires an adviser on every fund, so 11f is mostly adviser fees. The 0.46% asset-weighted cost is less than half the 1.00% used in the all-in table
